title: Rational Numbers
subtitle: Number Line & Coordinate Plane
bounds: Every number shown is an integer or a half (one decimal place, .5) of size <= 20; coordinates are integers of size 1..10; reciprocal distractors have denominators 2..12. Every hidden step is one + or - of two sizes <= 12 (absolute values), a move of <= 10 on a number line, or a distance of two coordinate sizes; every correct answer has size <= 20. Ordering uses at most 3 numbers.

tiers.name: Opposites & Signs
tiers.description: Opposites, numbers in real-world contexts, moving on a number line.

tiers.name: Absolute Value
tiers.description: Absolute value as distance from 0, and the size of a debt.

tiers.name: Compare & Order
tiers.description: Which is less, order from least to greatest, coldest and lowest.

tiers.name: Quadrants & Reflections
tiers.description: Quadrants from signs, and reflecting points over an axis.

tiers.name: Distance on the Plane
tiers.description: Distance between points that share a coordinate, and in stories.

SAME_NUMBER.student: The opposite is the same distance from 0 on the other side: 7 and −7.
SAME_NUMBER.teacher: Gives the number itself as its opposite.

RECIPROCAL.student: Opposite means switch the sign. Flipping into a fraction is the reciprocal.
RECIPROCAL.teacher: Confuses the opposite with the reciprocal (or the negative reciprocal).

WRONG_SIGN_CONTEXT.student: Below, owe, lose, down, withdraw are negative. Above, earn, gain, up are +.
WRONG_SIGN_CONTEXT.teacher: Assigns the wrong sign to a quantity described in words.

WRONG_DIRECTION.student: Right means bigger numbers. Left means smaller numbers.
WRONG_DIRECTION.teacher: Moves the wrong way on the number line.

FROM_ZERO.student: Start at the starting number, not at 0, then count the move.
FROM_ZERO.teacher: Counts the move from 0 instead of from the given start.

OFF_BY_ONE.student: Count the jumps between tick marks, not the tick marks themselves.
OFF_BY_ONE.teacher: Counts points instead of unit intervals (fencepost error).

KEEPS_SIGN.student: Absolute value is distance from 0, never negative: |−9| = 9.
KEEPS_SIGN.teacher: Keeps the negative sign inside absolute value bars.

OPPOSITE_FOR_ABS.student: Absolute value is not the opposite: |4| = 4 and |−4| = 4.
OPPOSITE_FOR_ABS.teacher: Takes the opposite instead of the absolute value, so |4| = −4.

POSITIVE_DEBT.student: A positive balance is money you have. A debt is a negative balance.
POSITIVE_DEBT.teacher: Reads the largest number as the largest debt, ignoring the sign.

NEG_SIZE.student: For negatives, a bigger size means less: −7 is less than −2.
NEG_SIZE.teacher: Orders negatives by magnitude, e.g. thinks −2 < −7.

ABS_ORDER.student: Signs matter: every negative is less than every positive.
ABS_ORDER.teacher: Orders numbers by absolute value, ignoring signs.

ZERO_LEAST.student: Negatives are less than 0: −3 is left of 0 on the number line.

GREATEST_FIRST.student: Least to greatest starts with the number farthest left.

CLOCKWISE.student: Quadrants go counterclockwise: I top right, II top left, III, IV.
CLOCKWISE.teacher: Numbers the quadrants clockwise (swaps II and IV).

SIGN_MISREAD.student: x sign: left (−) or right (+). y sign: down (−) or up (+). Check both.
SIGN_MISREAD.teacher: Places a point using the wrong sign on one or both coordinates.

NO_MOVE.student: A reflection moves the point to the other side of the axis.
NO_MOVE.teacher: Gives the original point's quadrant after a reflection.

WRONG_AXIS.student: Over the x-axis, y changes sign. Over the y-axis, x changes sign.

BOTH_FLIPPED.student: A reflection over one axis changes only one sign.
BOTH_FLIPPED.teacher: Negates both coordinates (a half turn about the origin).

SWAPPED_XY.student: Keep the order (x, y). A reflection does not swap them.

SUBTRACTED_SIZES.student: Opposite sides of 0: add the two distances to 0.
SUBTRACTED_SIZES.teacher: Subtracts magnitudes when the points straddle 0.

ADDED_SIZES.student: Same side of 0: subtract the sizes. −6 and −2 are 4 apart.
ADDED_SIZES.teacher: Adds magnitudes when the points are on the same side of 0.

NEG_DISTANCE.student: A distance is never negative. Take bigger minus smaller.
NEG_DISTANCE.teacher: Reports a signed difference as a distance.

TO_AXIS.student: That is only to the axis. The reflection is that far again: double it.
TO_AXIS.teacher: Gives the distance from the point to the axis, not to its image.

WRONG_COORD.student: Use the coordinate that changes, not the one that stays the same.
WRONG_COORD.teacher: Measures with the coordinate that is unchanged by the reflection.
